name: The Deadliest Gambit
source:
Meet Nick Gallant, your host for the murder mystery party of the decade, whose real secrets run even deeper than the game's.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Deadliest_Gambit]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
来认识一下尼克·加兰特吧——这位十年一遇谋杀之谜派对的东道主，他身上隐藏的真实秘密比这场游戏本身还要深不可测。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Deadliest_Gambit]Choices Wikia[/url]]
